articles.title: When Allen Iverson Dropped 30 In His NBA Debut! (30 Years Later) | November 1, 1996
articles.summary: Relive Allen Iverson’s NBA debut, 30 years later! 👑
body: On November 1, 1996, the No. 1 pick made his debut for the Philadelphia 76ers at home against the Milwaukee Bucks. Iverson finished with 30 points, six assists and a steal, shooting 12-for-19 from the floor and 2-for-4 from three. It was the most points in a career debut by a Sixers player in the last 50 years at that point. Milwaukee won, 111-103, but the Allen Iverson era had begun.

articles.title: Golden State Valkyries Make WNBA History! Gabby Williams Delivers Game 7 Masterclass | Chiney Today
body: In just their second season, the Golden State Valkyries made WNBA history by defeating the Atlanta Dream 68-63 in a winner-take-all Game 7. Golden State captured its first championship behind an unforgettable performance from Finals MVP Gabby Williams!

Chiney Ogwumike is joined by Ashanti Plummer LIVE from Ballhalla to break down Gabby's historic 30-point performance (including 28 points in the second half) and how Natalie Nakase led a team of overlooked players to a WNBA championship in just two seasons with the Golden State Valkyries.

Chiney and Ashanti break down Kiah Stokes' defensive dominance, Veronica Burton's clutch contributions, and Natalie Nakase's decision to sit Gabby Williams during a crucial time in the first half. They also discuss exactly what went wrong for Angel Reese and the Atlanta Dream in the second half. Chiney and Ashanti celebrate an unforgettable Game 7 and reflect on the WNBA's record-breaking 30th season.
